notes: Every product image on the ANDOR website is listed here. Masters are produced by the hidden [web-capture] test in tests/plugin/WebCaptureTests.inc of the OSP repository (real editor, ceramic look) and are not committed; run tools/capture.sh to regenerate them. Crops are in 1x editor coordinates (1448 x 1086) and are cut from the highest-resolution master.

sourceAudio.description: Deterministic synthetic test signals (A: vowel C4, B: pluck A3, C: vowel C3) from src/audio/utility/TestSignals. They are NOT recordings. Every capture must be re-shot with the approved demo recording(s) via OSP_WEB_SOURCES before launch.
